title: Report: DeepSeek Restarted the Second Round of 50 Billion Yuan Financing, Valuation Before Financing Rises to 500 Billion Yuan

content_html:
According to Caijing, DeepSeek, the leading domestic AI large model company, has officially restarted its second round of financing, planning to raise 50 billion yuan. The pre-investment valuation has reached about 500 billion yuan, and it is expected to complete the signing in late August. If this round is successfully closed, the total fundraising amount of DeepSeek in two rounds will exceed 100 billion yuan, with the valuation increasing by about 43% compared to the first round, further setting a new record for financing in the domestic AI field.

Looking back at its capital path, DeepSeek's first round of financing started in April this year and was completed in June, raising 50 billion yuan at a valuation of over 350 billion yuan, setting a new record for the largest first-round financing in domestic AI large model companies. This round attracted participation from state-owned enterprises, industrial giants, and top institutions such as the National Artificial Intelligence Industry Investment Fund, Tencent, CATL, NetEase, JD.com, and IDG Capital, with the intended funding scale once exceeding 100 billion yuan. Due to the limit of the first round, many backup investors moved on to the second round.

Although the second round of financing was initially launched in mid-July and briefly paused at the end of July, after restarting, DeepSeek and the investors have been proceeding more discreetly, with some early contacted institutions not yet receiving notice of the restart. In the current context of rapid development in AI large model research and intensified competition in computing power, the investment of hundreds of billions of yuan not only demonstrates the strong support of top-tier capital for the technological iteration and commercialization potential of leading domestic large models, but also will have a profound impact on industry differentiation and the construction of high computing power barriers.

content_html_zh:
据《财经》报道，国内领先的AI大模型公司DeepSeek已正式重启第二轮融资，拟融资500亿元。 前期投资估值已达约5000亿元，预计8月下旬完成签约。 若本轮顺利完成，DeepSeek两轮融资总额将突破1000亿元，估值较首轮提升约43%，进一步刷新国内人工智能领域融资新纪录。

回顾其资本之路，DeepSeek首轮融资从今年4月启动，6月完成，融资500亿元，估值超3500亿元，创下国内AI大模型公司最大首轮融资新纪录。 本轮吸引了国家人工智能产业投资基金、腾讯、宁德时代、网易、京东、IDG资本等国企、产业巨头及顶级机构参与，拟融资规模一度突破千亿元。 由于第一轮的限制，许多后备投资者进入了第二轮。

尽管第二轮融资最初于7月中旬启动，并于7月底短暂暂停，但重启后，DeepSeek和投资者的进展更加谨慎，一些早期接触的机构尚未收到重启通知。 在当前人工智能大模型研究快速发展、算力竞争加剧的背景下，千亿元的投资不仅体现了顶级资本对国内领先大模型的技术迭代和商业化潜力的大力支持，也将对行业差异化和高算力壁垒的构建产生深远影响。
